I am an undergraduate student at Purdue University studying Entomology with a minor in Political Science. My research interests include insect genetics, evolution, and molecular biology. I am especially interested in understanding how scientific research can inform policy makers and help bridge the gap between scientific discoveries and government decision-making. By working with Dr. Miles I hope to expand my knowledge of genetics, develop my lab skills, and gain more hands-on research experience.
